boundary_evidence: Opening, continuations and actual ending of one complete publisher-issued notice/filing, including all integrated sections. No invented scope.
notice_identity: Issuer, title, rule/docket, issuance/hearing/proceeding identity and source URL; preserve ambiguity.
dedup_evidence: Prior inventory original hash plus underlying issuer/title/rule/docket/date/source/page identity comparison, including current retained notices.
stratum_basis: Source-only basis for general versus conditional/relative/negative control; no expected answer or field values for evaluator use.
